answer: Each agent gets one staked identity; influence is weighted by locked collateral, not by key count. Cloning keys adds no voice, because weight comes from attestations signed by other staked agents, and an attestation that endorses a clone is slashable. To field k Sybils an attacker must lock k separate bonds and bribe k distinct honest signers, so cost rises linearly with identities, while one detected double-sign burns the entire bond. Honest agents follow the attestation signal to find a safe ledge of trust; a raft of hollow clones has no timber beneath it and sinks.
